info.title: IMEI-HUB API
info.description:
The Dhru Fusion compatible endpoint for GSM merchants.

**Authentication.** The Dhru Fusion endpoint takes the `username` and `apiaccesskey` form fields; a key has an optional IP allowlist and its own rate limit.

**Conventions.** JSON bodies use camelCase names. Money is a string with exactly four decimals (`"12.4900"`), timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds (`"2026-03-01T09:30:00.000Z"`) and ids are numbers. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`; quote the `requestId` when you contact support.

servers.description: The server that serves this document

post.description: The Dhru Fusion v6.1 compatible endpoint (decision 026): `username`, `apiaccesskey`, `action` and `parameters` (base64 of a JSON object) as a form body (`multipart/form-data` and JSON are accepted too). Eight actions: `accountinfo`, `imeiservicelist`, `placeimeiorder`, `placeimeiorderbulk`, `getimeiorder`, `getimeiorderbulk`, `placefileorder` and `getfileorder`. Every answer is HTTP 200 with the headers `X-Powered-By: DHRU-FUSION` and `dhru-fusion-api-version: 6.1` and the body `{ "SUCCESS": [ ... ], "apiversion": "6.1" }` or `{ "ERROR": [ { "MESSAGE": "..." } ], "apiversion": "6.1" }`; a bulk action answers `{ "<request id>": { "SUCCESS" | "ERROR": [ ... ] }, ..., "apiversion": "6.1" }`. A wrong credential is "Authentication Failed", an unknown action "Invalid Action". The allowed addresses and the per-minute limit of the key apply. A text in the decoded `parameters` or `CUSTOMFIELD` may not hold the character U+0000 or an unpaired surrogate.

oneOf.title: accountinfo
oneOf.description: Account info. The merchant's available balance (`credit`: the wallet balance plus the credit limit), email and currency. The key `AccoutInfo` is spelled as in the Dhru Fusion standard.

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

credit.description: What the merchant may spend now: balance plus credit limit.

oneOf.title: imeiservicelist
oneOf.description: IMEI service list. The IMEI, server and remote services the merchant may order, grouped by category, at its own price (`CREDIT`), with the quantity rules and the custom fields (`Requires.Custom`). File services are not listed. Archived and disabled services and categories the merchant's group may not see are never listed. Every price shown is remembered as the merchant's listed price (user rule 9).

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

QNT.description: `1` when the service sells more than one quantity.

QNTOPTIONS.description: The packs a service sells, comma separated; `""` when it sells a range.

fieldname.description: The field name: what `CUSTOMFIELD` takes, matched without regard to letter case. The field key is still accepted.

fieldoptions.description: The choices of a dropdown, comma separated; `""` otherwise.

oneOf.title: placeimeiorder
oneOf.description: Place an IMEI, server or remote order. Orders a service at the merchant's own price and holds it from the wallet. `ID` is the `SERVICEID` of `imeiservicelist`; an IMEI service takes its main input as `IMEI` (decision 073: an IMEI only when its main-input field is of type `imei`) and its other fields in `CUSTOMFIELD`, a server or remote service its custom fields in `CUSTOMFIELD`. The answer is immediate: `REFERENCEID` is our order id (status 0). A price that rose more than the tolerance above the price last listed is refused with "Price changed. Please refresh the service list and order again."; a balance that is too low with "Not enough credits". A File service is placed with `placefileorder`.

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

QNT.description: The quantity; defaults to the service's minimum.

CUSTOMFIELD.description: The values of the service custom fields by field name: base64 of a JSON object (an object is accepted too).

IMEI.description: The main input of an IMEI service: the value of its main-input field, judged by that field's type (an IMEI, 15 digits and Luhn, for the type `imei`), required tick and pattern; a service without such a field takes it as sent. Leave it out for a server or remote service.

oneOf.title: placeimeiorderbulk
oneOf.description: Place several orders. `parameters` is an object keyed by the caller's request id, each entry the parameters of `placeimeiorder`. The answer has one entry per request id: `{ "SUCCESS": [...] }` or `{ "ERROR": [...] }`. Each order is placed on its own (a refused one never stops the others); at most 100 per call. A request id has 1 to 64 characters. The call costs one point of the key’s per-minute limit per item (at most the whole limit).

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object keyed by your request id, one entry per order; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

QNT.description: The quantity; defaults to the service's minimum.

CUSTOMFIELD.description: The values of the service custom fields by field name: base64 of a JSON object (an object is accepted too).

IMEI.description: The main input of an IMEI service: the value of its main-input field, judged by that field's type (an IMEI, 15 digits and Luhn, for the type `imei`), required tick and pattern; a service without such a field takes it as sent. Leave it out for a server or remote service.

oneOf.title: getimeiorder
oneOf.description: Order status and result. `STATUS` 0 new, 1 in process, 3 rejected (refunded), 4 completed; `CODE` is the result of a completed order or the reason of a rejected one. Another account's order, and the account's own store order, like an unknown id, are an error.

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

ID.description: The order: the `REFERENCEID` the placement answered.

CODE.description: The result of a completed order, the reason of a rejected one; `""` while it runs.

oneOf.title: getimeiorderbulk
oneOf.description: Status of several orders. `parameters` is an object keyed by the caller's request id, each entry `{ "ID": <order> }`; the answer has one entry per request id with the `STATUS` and `CODE` of `getimeiorder` or an error; at most 100 per call. A request id has 1 to 64 characters.

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object keyed by your request id, one entry per order; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

ID.description: The order: the `REFERENCEID` the placement answered.

CODE.description: The result of a completed order, the reason of a rejected one; `""` while it runs.

oneOf.title: placefileorder
oneOf.description: Place a file order. Orders a File service. The file is `FILENAME` and `FILEDATA` (base64) in `parameters`, or a file part of a `multipart/form-data` request; it is stored like `POST /client/files` (up to 25 MiB). A form body of this endpoint may be up to 25 MiB (every other route keeps 1 MiB); `FILEDATA` is base64 inside the base64 `parameters`, so about 13 MiB of file fits a form: send a larger file as a multipart file part. Everything else is as `placeimeiorder`. A service that is not a File service is refused. If the order is refused (changed price, not enough credits), the uploaded file is not kept.

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

QNT.description: The quantity; defaults to the service's minimum.

CUSTOMFIELD.description: The values of the service custom fields by field name: base64 of a JSON object (an object is accepted too).

FILENAME.description: The name of the file, when it is sent as `FILEDATA`.

FILEDATA.description: The file: base64 of its content. A multipart request may send the file as a file part instead.

oneOf.title: getfileorder
oneOf.description: Result of a file order. As `getimeiorder`; when the result is a file, `FILEID` is its id: the merchant opens the file from its portal (`GET /client/files/:id`).

apiaccesskey.description: A merchant API key with the `dhru` scope.

parameters.description: Base64 of a JSON object; its shape is in `x-gsm-decoded`.

ID.description: The order: the `REFERENCEID` the placement answered.

CODE.description: The result of a completed order, the reason of a rejected one; `""` while it runs.

placeimeiorder.summary: Place an IMEI, server or remote order

200.description: Always HTTP 200 with the headers `X-Powered-By: DHRU-FUSION` and `dhru-fusion-api-version: 6.1`. A success is `{ "SUCCESS": [ ... ], "apiversion": "6.1" }`; a refusal (a wrong credential, an unknown action, a rejected order) is `{ "ERROR": [ { "MESSAGE": "..." } ], "apiversion": "6.1" }`. A bulk action answers one `SUCCESS` or `ERROR` list per request id.

placeimeiorder.summary: Place an IMEI, server or remote order

x-request-id.description: Id of this request; quote it when you report a problem.

dhruCredentials.description: Dhru Fusion credentials are not an HTTP header: send `username` and `apiaccesskey` as form fields in the request body. The key has an optional list of allowed IP addresses and its own requests-per-minute limit.
